callouts.title: 问题0
callouts.body: 令$$S_N:=\sum_{n\leq N}\sin(n^2)$$这是否为一个无界序列？

classification_result.id: 判断剧烈震荡的序列部分和的有界性问题#1

if_problem.statement_en: Let $$S_N:=\sum_{n\leq N}\sin(n^2).$$ Is this an unbounded sequence?

callouts.id: 判断剧烈震荡的序列部分和的有界性问题#2
callouts.title: 想法1.1.1：给此想法一个概率的背景
callouts.body: 考虑一族随参数$N$变化的有限概率空间$(\Omega_N,\mathcal{F}_N,\mathbb{P}_N)$其中$$\Omega_N:=\{1,2,\cdots,N\},\quad\mathcal{F}_N=2^{\Omega_N},\quad\mathbb{P}_N(A):=\frac{|A|}{N}$$在这个“舞台”上，从$\{1,2,\cdots,N\}$当中任选一个下标作为我们随机均匀选取的片段的起点，这件事可以表达为一个随机变量$K \sim U(\Omega_N)$，即$\Omega_N$上的均匀分布的随机变量。于是我们随机选取的长为$h$的序列$a_1,\cdots,a_N$的片段就是一列随机变量序列$$X_{N,i}(\omega):=a_{K(\omega)+i},\quad i=1,\cdots,h$$现在我们真正关心的其实是这一随机片段的和，也就是随机变量$$Y_{N,h}(\omega):=\sum_{i=1}^h X_{N,i}(\omega) $$如果此时我们知道$$\text{Var}_N(Y_{N,h})\to f(h)$$其中$f(h)>0$并且$f(h)\to +\infty$。那么我们可以断定，序列一定是无界的。因为$Y_{N,h}=S_{K+h}-S_{K}$如果$|S_N|\leq M$对任意正整数$N$成立，那么随机变量$Y_{N,h}$一定是具有上界$2M$的，从而方差对任意固定的$h$都有$$\limsup_{N\to \infty}\text{Var}_N(Y_{N,h})\leq 4M^2$$这就和我们对方差的假设矛盾了。因此$S_N$必然是无界序列。

if_strategy_template.strategy_name_en: Random-window variance criterion for unbounded partial sums
if_strategy_template.summary_en: Choose a random starting index and study the sum over a short random block as a random variable. If the variance of these block sums grows without bound with the block length, then the original partial sums cannot remain uniformly bounded.
if_strategy_template.applicability: Applies when a sequence is highly oscillatory and one can estimate the variance of sums over randomly chosen intervals of fixed length.

callouts.id: 判断剧烈震荡的序列部分和的有界性问题#3
callouts.title: 命题1.2.1: 问题0的推广
callouts.body: 设$$P(n):=a_dn^d+a_{d-1}n^{d-1}+\cdots+a_1 n +a_0\in \mathbb{R}[n],d\geq 2$$是次数至少为2的，系数$a_d,\cdots,a_2$当中至少有一个系数为无理数的多项式。设函数$F:\mathbb{T}\to \mathbb{C}$对应的傅里叶级数绝对收敛，并且积分为0。那么序列$$S_N(F):=\sum_{n=1}^{N}F\circ P(n)$$是一个无界序列。

classification_result.id: 判断剧烈震荡的序列部分和的有界性问题#3

if_problem.statement_en: Let $$P(n):=a_dn^d+a_{d-1}n^{d-1}+\cdots+a_1 n +a_0\in \mathbb{R}[n],\ d\geq 2,$$ be a polynomial of degree at least $2$ such that at least one of the coefficients $a_d,\ldots,a_2$ is irrational. Let $F:\mathbb{T}\to \mathbb{C}$ have an absolutely convergent Fourier series and satisfy $$\int_{\mathbb{T}} F=0.$$ Then the sequence $$S_N(F):=\sum_{n=1}^{N}F\circ P(n)$$ is unbounded.

callouts.id: 判断剧烈震荡的序列部分和的有界性问题#4
callouts.title: 引理1.2.2
callouts.body: 设$$P(n):=a_dn^d+a_{d-1}n^{d-1}+\cdots+a_1 n +a_0\in \mathbb{R}[n],d\geq 2$$是次数至少为2的，系数$a_d,\cdots,a_2$当中至少有一个系数为无理数的多项式。令$i\neq j\in \mathbb{Z}$，$(m_1,m_2)\in \mathbb{Z}^2\setminus \{(0,0)\}$则$$Q(n):=m_1P(n+i)-m_2P(n+j)$$是一个非常数多项式，并且它的非常数系数里至少有一个无理数。

classification_result.id: 判断剧烈震荡的序列部分和的有界性问题#4

if_problem.statement_en: Let $$P(n):=a_dn^d+a_{d-1}n^{d-1}+\cdots+a_1 n +a_0\in \mathbb{R}[n],\ d\geq 2,$$ be a polynomial of degree at least $2$ such that at least one of the coefficients $a_d,\ldots,a_2$ is irrational. Let $i\neq j\in \mathbb{Z}$ and $(m_1,m_2)\in \mathbb{Z}^2\setminus \{(0,0)\}$. Then $$Q(n):=m_1P(n+i)-m_2P(n+j)$$ is a nonconstant polynomial, and at least one of its nonconstant coefficients is irrational.
